items.title: De novo designed single-domain antibodies protect against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity in vivo
items.abstract_or_text: Generative protein design can now rapidly produce de novo binders with high affinity and functional activity against a wide range of targets, including lethal snake venom toxins. However, so far most reported successes rely on new-to-nature scaffolds with limited therapeutic precedent. Single-domain antibodies (VHHs) offer a clinically validated alternative scaffold that can bind and neutralize long-chain α-neurotoxins, which are some of the most lethal components in snake venoms. Here we compare three recently established de novo design models with VHH-design capabilities (Germinal, RFantibody, and BoltzGen) for their ability to generate VHHs against the neurotoxin α-cobratoxin from the monocled cobra ( Naja kaouthia ). Using standardized model inputs and evaluation criteria based on AlphaFold3 interface confidence (ipTM) and RMSD self-consistency, we find that Germinal was the only method to generate designs passing stringent in silico criteria for experimental testing. We therefore performed a larger Germinal design campaign employing three different VHH frameworks and experimentally validated 46 designs in vitro . Of these, 42 expressed as soluble proteins and we identified four binding hits derived from two of the three tested frameworks. Of the four binders, two lead candidates were further characterized and demonstrated high affinity (KDs of 4.1 nM and 10.8 nM), monomeric behavior and low polyreactivity, indicating favorable biophysical and developability properties, as well as functional toxin neutralization in vitro . To assess their therapeutic potential we investigated their ability to protect against α-cobratoxin toxicity in vivo . Both candidates fully protected mice after α-cobratoxin challenge, with 100% survival compared to a lethal control. One candidate also retained notable neutralization capacity against whole venom of Naja kaouthia with a survival of 56%, while the other protected 22% when tested in a rescue setting. Together, we demonstrate that de novo VHH design can generate high affinity single-domain antibodies with in vivo protection against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity, and provide practical insights into method- and framework-dependent performance.
items.summary_zh: 从头设计单域抗体在小鼠中抵御致死性眼镜蛇神经毒素
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把生成式蛋白设计推进到体内保护验证：两种 de novo VHH 在 α-cobratoxin 攻击后使小鼠 100% 存活，并显示了对全蛇毒的有限中和能力。其结果仍需在更多毒素、剂量和临床前模型中复核。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式蛋白设计如今能够迅速产生针对多类靶标、具有高亲和力和功能活性的从头结合蛋白，其中包括致死性蛇毒毒素。然而，迄今报道的大多数成功案例依赖于缺少治疗先例的新颖支架。单域抗体（VHH）是一种经过临床验证的替代支架，可结合并中和长链 α-neurotoxins；后者是蛇毒中最致命的成分之一。我们在针对单片眼镜蛇（Naja kaouthia）神经毒素 α-cobratoxin 的任务上，比较了三种近期建立、具有 VHH 设计能力的从头设计模型（Germinal、RFantibody 和 BoltzGen）。采用标准化的模型输入，以及基于 AlphaFold3 界面置信度（ipTM）和 RMSD 自洽性的评价标准后，我们发现只有 Germinal 生成的设计通过了用于实验测试的严格 in silico 标准。因此，我们开展了一项规模更大的 Germinal 设计活动，采用三种不同的 VHH 框架，并在体外实验中验证了 46 个设计。其中，42 个可表达为可溶性蛋白；我们从测试的三个框架中的两个获得了 4 个结合命中物。在这 4 个结合蛋白中，进一步表征了两个先导候选物；它们显示出高亲和力（KD 分别为 4.1 nM 和 10.8 nM）、单体行为和低多反应性，提示具有良好的生物物理性质和可开发性，同时也在体外实现了功能性毒素中和。为评估其治疗潜力，我们研究了它们抵御 α-cobratoxin 毒性的体内能力。两种候选物在 α-cobratoxin 攻击后均完全保护小鼠，存活率为 100%，而致死对照组无此表现。其中一个候选物对 Naja kaouthia 全蛇毒仍保留显著的中和能力，存活率为 56%；另一个在救援给药条件下保护了 22%。综上，我们证明从头 VHH 设计能够产生可在体内抵御致死性眼镜蛇神经毒性的高亲和力单域抗体，并为理解方法和框架依赖的性能提供了实用见解。
items.author_line: Overath MD, Lundquist EVS, Björnsson KH, Kerwin S, Jacobsen CP, Møiniche MvB, Espi DR, Boddum K, Benard-Valle M, Fernández-Quintero ML, Mackessy SP, Jenkins TP

items.title: scRep: A Latent-Space Self-Distilled Foundation Model for Single-Cell Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models have shown strong potential for learning transferable representations from large-scale transcriptomic data. However, many existing approaches rely on reconstructing masked gene expression values, creating a potential mismatch between observation-space reconstruction and the goal of learning stable biological representations. This challenge is particularly relevant to single-cell RNA sequencing, where sparsity, incomplete gene detection, and technical variation can obscure the underlying biological state. Here, we introduce scRep, a compact latent-space self-distillation framework for single-cell representation learning. Rather than reconstructing raw expression values, scRep aligns differently perturbed views of the same cell through a momentum-updated teacher--student architecture, with self-distillation objectives at both the cell and gene levels. This representation-centered formulation encourages the model to capture biological information that remains stable across incomplete and perturbed transcriptomic observations. Using frozen representations without task-specific fine-tuning, scRep pretrained on approximately 2.8 million cells achieves the strongest overall performance across the evaluated frozen-representation benchmarks, demonstrating strong sample efficiency. A larger-scale scRep model pretrained on 30.72 million cells further demonstrates that the framework remains effective when scaled to a substantially larger and more diverse corpus. Beyond cell identity, scRep prioritizes established marker genes, recovers transcription factor--associated gene programs with cell-type-specific activity, and preserves continuous developmental structure that supports graph-based pseudotime inference. We further show that pretraining performance is closely associated with biological diversity: reducing redundant cells while improving cell-type coverage can match or exceed the performance of larger, less balanced training corpora. Together, these results establish latent-space self-distillation as an effective alternative to expression reconstruction for single-cell foundation modeling and suggest that efficient scaling depends not only on the number of cells, but also on the learning objective and the biological diversity of the pretraining corpus.
items.summary_zh: scRep：以潜在空间自蒸馏学习单细胞表征的基础模型
items.why_it_matters_zh: scRep 在约 280 万细胞预训练时已在冻结表征基准中总体最强，并扩展到 3,072 万细胞；其结果提示单细胞基础模型的训练目标和细胞类型多样性，与训练细胞数量同样关键。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型在从大规模转录组数据学习可迁移表征方面显示出很大潜力。然而，许多现有方法依赖于重建被掩蔽的基因表达值，这可能使观测空间重建与学习稳定生物学表征的目标不匹配。对于单细胞 RNA 测序，这一挑战尤其突出，因为稀疏性、基因检出不完整和技术变异会掩盖底层生物学状态。本文提出 scRep，一个紧凑的潜在空间自蒸馏单细胞表征学习框架。scRep 不重建原始表达值，而是通过动量更新的教师—学生架构，对同一细胞的不同扰动视图进行对齐，并在细胞和基因两个层面采用自蒸馏目标。这种以表征为中心的表述鼓励模型捕捉在不完整和受扰动转录组观测下仍然稳定的生物学信息。使用无需任务特异微调的冻结表征，在约 2.8 million 个细胞上预训练的 scRep 在所评估的冻结表征基准中取得总体最强性能，并显示出很强的样本效率。在 30.72 million 个细胞上预训练的更大规模 scRep 模型进一步表明，该框架在扩展至显著更大、更具多样性的语料时仍然有效。除细胞身份外，scRep 还优先识别已确立的标记基因，恢复具有细胞类型特异活性的转录因子相关基因程序，并保留支持基于图的拟时序推断的连续发育结构。我们进一步显示，预训练性能与生物学多样性密切相关：在提升细胞类型覆盖度的同时减少冗余细胞，可以达到或超过更大但均衡性较差训练语料的性能。综上，这些结果确立了潜在空间自蒸馏作为单细胞基础模型中表达重建的有效替代方案，并提示高效扩展不仅取决于细胞数量，也取决于学习目标和预训练语料的生物学多样性。
items.author_line: Wang, S., Hu, Z., Bie, Y., Yin, Q., Chen, H., Li, Q.

items.title: DeepCNet: A multimodal deep learning model for predicting cell type-specific gene expression and promoter-enhancer interactions from single-cell multiome data
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Understanding promoter-enhancer (PE) interactions is essential for elucidating gene regulation mechanisms. Although existing computational methods leverage DNA sequence to predict gene expression, many were developed primarily for bulk-level genomic data and emphasize predictive accuracy rather than regulatory inference. Here, we propose DeepCNet, a multimodal deep learning framework that predicts cell type-specific gene expression and infers cell type-specific PE interactions, enabling the construction of transcription factor gene regulatory networks (TF-GRNs) from single-cell multiome data. Evaluated on two single-cell multiome datasets from blood and brain tissues, DeepCNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in predicting cell type-specific gene expression. Importantly, PE interactions inferred by DeepCNet showed greater concordance with orthogonal chromatin interaction and CRISPR perturbation data than competing approaches. Analysis of cell type–specific GRNs identified TF hubs and highlighted both cell type–specific and shared regulatory programs. DeepCNet further extends to two-condition single-cell multiome studies, enabling the identification of differential PE interactions and characterization of TF-GRN alterations across conditions. As an illustrative application, we applied DeepCNet to single-cell multiome data from one Alzheimer's disease (AD) and one healthy control sample, identifying candidate differential PE interactions at AD risk loci and candidate TF hubs associated with AD-related pathways. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of DeepCNet to characterize transcriptional regulatory programs and cooperative TF interactions underlying cell type- and condition-specific gene expression.
items.summary_zh: DeepCNet 从单细胞 multiome 数据预测细胞类型特异的表达与启动子—增强子互作
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在血液和脑组织的两个单细胞 multiome 数据集上比较，并以独立染色质互作与 CRISPR 扰动数据检验推断的 PE 互作；AD 示例仅含 1 个病例与 1 个对照，适合作为方法展示。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 理解启动子—增强子（PE）互作对于阐明基因调控机制至关重要。尽管现有计算方法利用 DNA 序列预测基因表达，但许多方法主要为批量基因组数据开发，强调预测准确性而非调控推断。本文提出 DeepCNet，一个多模态深度学习框架，用于预测细胞类型特异的基因表达并推断细胞类型特异的 PE 互作，从而可由单细胞 multiome 数据构建转录因子基因调控网络（TF-GRNs）。在来自血液和脑组织的两个单细胞 multiome 数据集上评估时，DeepCNet 在预测细胞类型特异的基因表达方面持续优于当前最先进方法。重要的是，与竞争方法相比，DeepCNet 推断的 PE 互作与正交染色质互作和 CRISPR 扰动数据具有更高一致性。对细胞类型特异 GRNs 的分析识别出 TF 枢纽，并突出显示了细胞类型特异和共享的调控程序。DeepCNet 还可扩展至双条件单细胞 multiome 研究，能够识别差异 PE 互作，并刻画跨条件的 TF-GRN 改变。作为示例应用，我们将 DeepCNet 应用于 1 个 Alzheimer's disease（AD）样本和 1 个健康对照样本的单细胞 multiome 数据，在 AD 风险位点识别出候选差异 PE 互作和与 AD 相关通路有关的候选 TF 枢纽。综上，这些结果显示 DeepCNet 有潜力刻画细胞类型和条件特异基因表达背后的转录调控程序及协同 TF 互作。
items.author_line: Chen L, Jin W, Zhao F, Ma X, Lu Q, Esser K, Sun R

items.title: Single-cell multi-omics maps clonal IEL expansion and epithelial remodelling in refractory coeliac disease
items.abstract_or_text: Background Refractory coeliac disease type 1 (RCD1) lacks defining molecular markers, and the immune and epithelial mechanisms sustaining intestinal injury remain poorly understood. Objective To define the clonal immune and epithelial states that distinguish RCD1 from active coeliac disease (ACD) and determine their spatial organisation in the duodenal mucosa. Design We integrated single-cell RNA sequencing, CITE-seq surface proteomics and paired T-cell receptor sequencing of duodenal immune and epithelial compartments from Healthy controls (n = 6), ACD (n = 7), RCD1 (n = 9) and RCD2 (n = 2), with spatial transcriptomics in a subset of biopsies. Results RCD1 showed widespread TCR{beta} and TCR{gamma}{delta} clonal expansion across multiple IEL states, extending beyond previously defined mutation-bearing aberrant clones. Distinct IEL populations converged on a shared programme of adaptive persistence, innate-like signalling, metabolic fitness and cytoskeletal remodelling; GZMK expression marked both clonally expanded and non-clonal disease-associated states. In parallel, RCD1 epithelium showed loss of mature absorptive cell states and expansion of stress-associated, immune-interacting and regenerative programmes. Transit-amplifying cells acquired differentiation and tissue-remodelling signatures, while enteroendocrine cells expanded and developed a sensory-neurosecretory programme involving TRPA1, TRPV1, vesicle trafficking and NEUROD1 regulon activity. Spatial transcriptomics localised regenerative and enteroendocrine-associated epithelial programmes adjacent to immune-visible epithelial regions and KLRK1/GZMK-expressing IEL-rich niches in refractory tissue. Conclusion RCD1 represents a distinct mucosal state characterised by coordinated clonal IEL adaptation and epithelial remodelling, rather than simple amplification of ACD, providing a cellular framework for persistent tissue injury and disease stratification.
items.summary_zh: 单细胞多组学绘制难治性乳糜泻中的克隆性 IEL 扩增和上皮重塑
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究整合 scRNA-seq、CITE-seq、配对 TCR 测序与空间转录组，比较 Healthy、ACD、RCD1 和 RCD2 活检，为持续性肠黏膜损伤及患者分型提出细胞学框架。
items.abstract_zh: 背景 难治性乳糜泻 1 型（RCD1）缺乏明确的分子标志物，维持肠道损伤的免疫和上皮机制仍知之甚少。目的 确定使 RCD1 区别于活动性乳糜泻（ACD）的克隆性免疫和上皮状态，并确定它们在十二指肠黏膜中的空间组织。设计 我们整合了来自 Healthy controls（n = 6）、ACD（n = 7）、RCD1（n = 9）和 RCD2（n = 2）的十二指肠免疫与上皮区室的单细胞 RNA 测序、CITE-seq 表面蛋白质组学和配对 T-cell receptor 测序，并在一部分活检中进行了空间转录组学。结果 RCD1 在多种 IEL 状态中显示广泛的 TCRβ 和 TCRγδ 克隆扩增，超出了既往定义的携带突变的异常克隆。不同 IEL 群体汇聚至一个共同程序，包括适应性持续存在、先天样信号传导、代谢适能和细胞骨架重塑；GZMK 表达同时标记克隆扩增和非克隆的疾病相关状态。与此同时，RCD1 上皮表现出成熟吸收细胞状态丧失，并扩增应激相关、免疫互作和再生程序。Transit-amplifying cells 获得分化和组织重塑特征，而 enteroendocrine cells 扩增，并形成涉及 TRPA1、TRPV1、囊泡运输和 NEUROD1 regulon 活性的感觉—神经分泌程序。空间转录组学将再生和 enteroendocrine-associated 上皮程序定位在难治性组织中邻近免疫可见上皮区域和富含 KLRK1/GZMK 表达 IEL 的生态位。结论 RCD1 是一种独特的黏膜状态，其特征是协调的克隆性 IEL 适应和上皮重塑，而非 ACD 的简单放大；这一发现为持续性组织损伤和疾病分型提供了细胞学框架。

items.title: SCALE: Scalable Conditional Atlas-Level Endpoint transport for virtual cell perturbation prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Virtual cell models aim to enable in silico experimentation by predicting how cells respond to genetic, chemical, or cytokine perturbations from single-cell measurements. In practice, however, large-scale perturbation prediction remains constrained by three coupled bottlenecks: inefficient training and inference pipelines, unstable modeling in high-dimensional sparse expression space, and evaluation protocols that overemphasize reconstruction-like accuracy while underestimating biological fidelity. In this work we present a specialized large-scale foundation model SCALE for virtual cell perturbation prediction that addresses the above limitations jointly. First, we build a BioNeMo-based training and inference framework that substantially improves data throughput, distributed scalability, and deployment efficiency, yielding 12.51* speedup on pretrain and 1.29* on inference over the prior SOTA pipeline under matched system settings. Second, we formulate perturbation prediction as conditional transport and implement it with a set-aware flow architecture that couples LLaMA-based cellular encoding with endpoint-oriented supervision. This design yields more stable training and stronger recovery of perturbation effects. Third, we evaluate the model on Tahoe-100M using a rigorous cell-level protocol centered on biologically meaningful metrics rather than reconstruction alone. On this benchmark, our model improves PDCorr by 12.02% and DE Overlap by 10.66% over STATE. Together, these results suggest that advancing virtual cells requires not only better generative objectives, but also the co-design of scalable infrastructure, stable transport modeling, and biologically faithful evaluation.
items.summary_zh: SCALE：面向虚拟细胞扰动预测的可扩展条件运输模型
items.why_it_matters_zh: SCALE 在 Tahoe-100M 上以细胞层面的生物学指标评估，相比 STATE 报告 PDCorr 提升 12.02%、DE Overlap 提升 10.66%，并给出在匹配系统设置下的训练和推理吞吐量比较。
items.abstract_zh: 虚拟细胞模型旨在通过单细胞测量预测细胞对遗传、化学或细胞因子扰动的响应，从而实现 in silico 实验。然而，在实践中，大规模扰动预测仍受三个相互关联的瓶颈制约：训练和推理流程效率低下、高维稀疏表达空间中的建模不稳定，以及评估方案过度强调类重建准确性而低估生物学保真度。本文提出用于虚拟细胞扰动预测的专用大规模基础模型 SCALE，同时解决上述限制。首先，我们构建了一个基于 BioNeMo 的训练和推理框架，显著提升数据吞吐、分布式可扩展性和部署效率；在匹配的系统设置下，相比既有 SOTA 流程，预训练速度提升 12.51* 倍、推理速度提升 1.29* 倍。其次，我们将扰动预测表述为条件运输，并以集合感知的流架构实现；该架构将基于 LLaMA 的细胞编码与以终点为导向的监督耦合。这一设计带来更稳定的训练和更强的扰动效应恢复能力。第三，我们在 Tahoe-100M 上使用严格的细胞层面方案评估模型，该方案以具有生物学意义的指标为中心，而非仅考察重建。在这一基准上，模型相对 STATE 的 PDCorr 提升 12.02%，DE Overlap 提升 10.66%。综上，这些结果提示，推进虚拟细胞不仅需要更好的生成目标，也需要可扩展基础设施、稳定的运输建模和生物学保真评估的协同设计。
items.author_line: Chen, S., Yu, L., Lin, X., Mao, X., Zhang, S., Gu, X., Wu, H., Xu, S., Jin, K., Bai, L., Qian, Q., Chen, Q., Gao, Q., Sun, S., Gao, Z.

items.title: Towards Sparse Causal Features for Zero-shot Mutation Effect Prediction in a Protein Language Model
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (pLMs) such as ESM-2 achieve strong zero-shot mutation-effect prediction, yet the internal computations supporting these predictions remain poorly understood. We introduce a sparse feature circuit framework that combines sparse autoencoders, integrated-gradients attribution, and activation patching to identify the latent features that causally mediate zero-shot mutation effect prediction in ESM-2 650M. We evaluate this framework over 67 mutations ranging from strongly deleterious to weakly deleterious in the DNAJA1 J-domain, where ESM-2 predictions agree strongly with deep mutational scanning measurements. We find that circuits selected by indirect effect recover the model's predictions more efficiently and provide more informative biological explanations than those selected by raw activation changes, showing that activation magnitude does not necessarily reflect causal importance. We find that related substitutions reuse substantial portions of their recovered circuits, ranging from 40% to 75%, and that the shared features often represent residues in three-dimensional contact with the mutation site. To our knowledge, our work provides the first causal, feature-level account of zero-shot mutation effect prediction in a pLM.
items.summary_zh: 用稀疏因果特征解释蛋白质语言模型的零样本突变效应预测
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作在 ESM-2 650M 中结合稀疏自编码器、integrated gradients 和 activation patching，将模型预测关联至可检验的特征电路；验证范围为 DNAJA1 J-domain 的 67 个突变。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）如 ESM-2 在零样本突变效应预测中取得强劲表现，但支撑这些预测的内部计算过程仍知之甚少。我们引入稀疏特征电路框架，结合稀疏自编码器、integrated-gradients attribution 和 activation patching，以识别在 ESM-2 650M 中因果介导零样本突变效应预测的潜在特征。我们在 DNAJA1 J-domain 的 67 个突变上评估该框架，这些突变从强有害到弱有害不等，且 ESM-2 预测与深度突变扫描测量结果高度一致。我们发现，按间接效应选择的电路比按原始激活变化选择的电路能更高效地恢复模型预测，并提供更具信息量的生物学解释，表明激活幅度并不一定反映因果重要性。我们发现，相关替换会复用其恢复电路中的很大部分，范围为 40% 至 75%；共享特征通常表征与突变位点在三维结构上接触的残基。据我们所知，本工作首次在特征层面提供了对 pLM 零样本突变效应预测的因果解释。
items.author_line: Mohanty, S., Phutela, M., Green, A. G.

items.title: Evaluating Clinical Foundation Models for Early Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementia Prediction from Longitudinal EHRs
items.abstract_or_text: Early identification of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) remains challenging despite its importance for timely intervention, management of modifiable risk factors, and care planning. We developed and evaluated ADRD onset prediction models using longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) from the All of Us Research Program at clinically meaningful lead times of 6, 12, 24, and 36 months before diagnosis, benchmarking interpretable count-based representations against four publicly available pretrained clinical foundation models (CLMBR-T, GPT-style, LLaMA-style, and Mamba) across multiple ADRD phenotype definitions. Count-based models consistently achieved the highest discrimination and calibration across all cohorts and prediction horizons. Predictive performance declined with increasing lead time for all approaches; however, the performance gap between count-based and pretrained representations progressively narrowed, with foundation models achieving comparable AUROC of 0.719 (compared to the AUROC of 0.738 of count-based model) at the 36-month horizon while providing higher sensitivity and F1 scores under a fixed operating threshold. External validation with zero-shot evaluation on UChicago EHRs exhibited limited generalizability for count-based and pretrained clinical foundation model based representations. These findings demonstrate that transparent count-based EHR representations remain the strongest overall approach for ADRD onset prediction, while pretrained clinical foundation models provide complementary advantages for long-term risk identification and establish a benchmark for evaluating transferable clinical representations in temporal ADRD risk prediction.
items.summary_zh: 在纵向 EHR 中评估临床基础模型对早期 ADRD 的预测能力
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究使用 All of Us 纵向 EHR，在 6、12、24 和 36 个月预测时距上与四种公开临床基础模型比较，并以 UChicago EHR 零样本外部测试考察可迁移性；两类方法的外部泛化均有限。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管早期识别 Alzheimer's disease and related dementias（ADRD）对于及时干预、可改变风险因素的管理和照护规划十分重要，但这一任务仍具挑战。我们使用 All of Us Research Program 的纵向电子健康记录（EHRs），在诊断前具有临床意义的 6、12、24 和 36 个月预测时距上开发并评估 ADRD 发病预测模型；研究将可解释的计数型表征与四种公开可用的预训练临床基础模型（CLMBR-T、GPT-style、LLaMA-style 和 Mamba）进行比较，并覆盖多种 ADRD 表型定义。计数型模型在所有队列和预测时距中持续获得最高的判别能力和校准度。对于所有方法，预测性能都会随着预测时距增加而下降；不过，计数型和预训练表征之间的性能差距逐渐缩小，在 36 个月时距下，基础模型达到可比较的 AUROC 0.719（计数型模型的 AUROC 为 0.738），同时在固定运行阈值下具有更高的敏感性和 F1 scores。使用 UChicago EHRs 进行零样本评估的外部验证显示，计数型和预训练临床基础模型表征的泛化能力均有限。这些发现表明，透明的计数型 EHR 表征仍是 ADRD 发病预测中总体最强的方法；同时，预训练临床基础模型为长期风险识别提供互补优势，并为评估时间性 ADRD 风险预测中可迁移的临床表征建立了基准。
items.author_line: Farzana, S., Arian, A., Rundek, T., Desvarieux, M., Ahsan, H.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Community Eye Screening in Primary Healthcare: A Prospective Multicentre Diagnostic Accuracy and Implementation Study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted retinal screening may extend access to eye care in primary healthcare, but prospective evidence on diagnostic performance and implementation under routine community conditions remains limited. Methods We conducted a prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy and implementation study across 12 urban and rural community eye-screening centres in India from 1 January to 30 June 2025. Adults aged ≥18 years underwent AI-assisted retinal-image analysis followed by masked comprehensive ophthalmic examination. The primary outcome was participant-level diagnostic accuracy of the AI-generated referral classification for the composite reference-standard outcome of any referable ocular disease. Implementation outcomes included image-acquisition success, workflow completion, referral compliance, screening time, and questionnaire-based acceptance and satisfaction. Results Among 1,732 participants, 610 (35.2%) had referable ocular disease. The AI system produced 566 true-positive, 1,017 true-negative, 105 false-positive, and 44 false-negative classifications. Sensitivity was 92.8% (95% CI 90.4%–94.7%), specificity 90.6% (88.8%–92.3%), positive predictive value 84.4% (81.4%–87.0%), negative predictive value 95.9% (94.5%–97.0%), and overall accuracy 91.4% (90.0%–92.7%). The F1 score was 0.884, Cohen’s kappa was 0.816, and the AUC based on the three-level AI risk classification was 0.925 (bootstrap 95% CI 0.912–0.937). Image acquisition succeeded in 1,668 participants (96.3%), workflow completion was 98.7%, and referral compliance was 550/671 (82.0%). Mean community-acceptance, healthcare-provider-satisfaction, and participant-satisfaction scores were 4.56, 4.44, and 4.49, respectively. Conclusions AI-assisted community eye screening showed high sensitivity and good overall diagnostic performance with strong operational feasibility. The false-positive burden, particularly among participants with diabetes, supports continued clinical oversight, image-quality assurance, and subgroup-specific validation before wider health-system adoption.
items.summary_zh: AI 辅助基层社区眼筛查的前瞻性多中心诊断准确性与实施研究
items.why_it_matters_zh: 印度 12 个城乡中心的 1,732 名成人前瞻性研究提供了真实工作流程指标及置信区间。系统仍有假阳性负担，尤其在糖尿病参与者中，因此需要临床复核和亚组验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：AI 辅助视网膜筛查或可扩大基层卫生服务中的眼科照护可及性，但在常规社区条件下有关诊断性能和实施情况的前瞻性证据仍有限。方法：我们于 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 6 月 30 日，在印度 12 个城乡社区眼筛查中心开展前瞻性多中心诊断准确性和实施研究。年龄 ≥18 岁的成人接受 AI 辅助视网膜图像分析，随后接受盲法综合眼科检查。主要结局是 AI 生成的转诊分类对于“任何需转诊眼病”这一复合参考标准结局的参与者层面诊断准确性。实施结局包括图像采集成功、工作流程完成、转诊依从性、筛查时间，以及基于问卷的接受度和满意度。结果：在 1,732 名参与者中，610 名（35.2%）存在需转诊眼病。AI 系统产生 566 个真阳性、1,017 个真阴性、105 个假阳性和 44 个假阴性分类。敏感性为 92.8%（95% CI 90.4%–94.7%），特异性为 90.6%（88.8%–92.3%），阳性预测值为 84.4%（81.4%–87.0%），阴性预测值为 95.9%（94.5%–97.0%），总体准确率为 91.4%（90.0%–92.7%）。F1 score 为 0.884，Cohen’s kappa 为 0.816，基于三级 AI 风险分类的 AUC 为 0.925（bootstrap 95% CI 0.912–0.937）。1,668 名参与者（96.3%）图像采集成功，工作流程完成率为 98.7%，转诊依从性为 550/671（82.0%）。社区接受度、医疗服务提供者满意度和参与者满意度的平均分分别为 4.56、4.44 和 4.49。结论：AI 辅助社区眼筛查显示出高敏感性、良好的总体诊断性能和较强的操作可行性。假阳性负担，尤其是在糖尿病参与者中，支持在更广泛卫生系统采用前继续进行临床监督、图像质量保证和亚组特异验证。
items.author_line: Mukhopadhyay D, Varshney A, Mandal R, Chakraborty S, Jahir S, Dingal A, Biswas A, Nair V, Masemola HC, Mukhopadhyay S, Mukherjee S, Mukherjee H

items.title: VITAL-3D: Volumetric Single-Cell Quantification Reveals Microenvironment-Dependent Drug Responses in Breast Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Preclinical drug evaluation relies heavily on two-dimensional (2D) monolayer assays, which fail to recapitulate the structural and functional complexity of the tumor microenvironment and may therefore misrepresent therapeutic efficacy. Here, we present VITAL (Volumetric Imaging-based Toxicity and Live Analysis), a high-throughput imaging platform that enables direct single-cell quantification of proliferation and cell death in both 2D and three-dimensional (3D) extracellular matrix (ECM) cultures using a 96-well format. By combining volumetric imaging with automated single-cell analysis, VITAL enables dynamic assessment of drug responses beyond conventional viability assays and EC₅₀ measurements. Using breast cancer cell lines treated with anticancer agents, we systematically compared drug responses between 2D and 3D microenvironments. Although EC₅₀ values were often comparable between culture formats, growth kinetics and concentrations required to induce complete growth arrest or net cell loss differed substantially in 3D cultures. In particular, drug concentrations required to induce net cell loss were consistently higher in 3D, revealing microenvironment-dependent survival responses that were not captured by EC₅₀ alone. Furthermore, clinically expected subtype-specific responses, including tamoxifen sensitivity in ER-positive cells and olaparib sensitivity in BRCA1-mutant cells, were more accurately resolved under 3D culture conditions and extended treatment durations. Together, these findings demonstrate that growth-based, single-cell quantification provides a more comprehensive assessment of therapeutic efficacy than conventional endpoint measurements and establish VITAL as a scalable platform for physiologically relevant preclinical drug screening.
items.summary_zh: VITAL-3D 以体积单细胞定量识别乳腺癌中依赖微环境的药物响应
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该 96 孔三维成像平台比较 2D 与 3D ECM 培养，显示相近的 EC₅₀ 仍可对应明显不同的生长动力学和细胞净损失剂量，为临床前药物筛选提供更接近组织环境的读数。
items.abstract_zh: 临床前药物评价高度依赖二维（2D）单层实验；这类实验无法重现肿瘤微环境的结构和功能复杂性，因而可能错误表征治疗效果。本文提出 VITAL（Volumetric Imaging-based Toxicity and Live Analysis），一个高通量成像平台，采用 96 孔形式，通过体积成像和自动化单细胞分析，能够直接定量二维和三维（3D）细胞外基质（ECM）培养中的细胞增殖和死亡。VITAL 超越传统活力实验和 EC₅₀ 测量，可动态评估药物响应。我们使用抗癌药物处理的乳腺癌细胞系，系统比较二维和三维微环境中的药物响应。尽管不同培养形式的 EC₅₀ 值通常相近，但三维培养中生长动力学以及实现完全生长停滞或细胞数量净减少所需的药物浓度存在显著差异。特别是，在三维培养中诱导细胞数量净减少所需的药物浓度持续更高，揭示出单靠 EC₅₀ 无法捕捉的、依赖微环境的存活响应。此外，在三维培养条件和延长治疗时间下，临床预期的亚型特异响应得到更准确解析，包括 ER-positive 细胞对 tamoxifen 的敏感性以及 BRCA1-mutant 细胞对 olaparib 的敏感性。综上，这些发现表明，基于生长的单细胞定量比传统终点测量更全面地评估治疗效力，并将 VITAL 确立为可扩展、具有生理相关性的临床前药物筛选平台。
items.author_line: Wu P, Jin C, Chu T, Zhang Q, Wirtz D

items.title: A COJEC-chemotherapy resistant model of Th-ALK(F1174L)/MYCN neuroblastoma offers insights into tumour immune evasion and development of the bone marrow metastatic niche
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-agent COJEC chemotherapy is the main-stay of induction treatment for patients diagnosed with high-risk neuroblastoma. However, at least 10% of patients will be primary refractory to chemotherapy and only 50% achieve 5-year overall survival. The bone marrow is the most frequent site of metastasis in these patients. Novel approaches are required to improve response rates but the inter- and intra- patient tumour heterogeneity and dynamics of the neuroblastoma immune microenvironment makes anticipation of resistance phenotypes incredibly challenging. We present here a novel immunocompetent C57 Bl/6 model of Th-ALK(F1174L)/MYCN neuroblastoma, in which spontaneous abdominal tumours are driven by expression of mutant Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase and over-expression of Mycn in the neural crest. We have used this model to generate a personalised dosing schedule inducing COJEC-chemotherapy resistance, in which individual mice receive chemotherapy cycles dependent upon the progression of their neuroblastoma tumours. Using both single cell RNA sequencing and spatial immunophenotyping gave us extraordinary precision in our comprehensive analysis of the tumour intrinsic and microenvironmental factors associated with COJEC resistance. We found that the resistance phenotype was driven by Cdk8 upregulation in adrenergic and mesenchymal tumour cells. Infiltration of immunosuppressive myeloid-derived immune cells and remodeling of the tumour-associated stroma further contributed to COJEC resistance. In the bone marrow we observed expansion of neutrophils and evidence of NETosis associated with micro-metastatic disease. Our results further endorse the development of CDK8-targeting therapeutics for neuroblastoma patients which might boost the anti-tumour immune response. Additional studies will be required to define the roles of neutrophils and neutrophil NETosis in neuroblastoma progression and metastasis. Our C57 Bl/6 model will be pivotal in future preclinical studies of immune-modulating therapeutics.
items.summary_zh: COJEC 耐药 Th-ALK(F1174L)/MYCN 神经母细胞瘤模型研究免疫逃逸和骨髓转移生态位
items.why_it_matters_zh: 免疫健全小鼠模型结合个体化给药、单细胞 RNA 测序和空间免疫表型分析，支持在该模型中研究与耐药相关的 Cdk8 上调、髓系浸润和骨髓中性粒细胞改变；其治疗推论尚待进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 多药 COJEC 化疗是确诊高危神经母细胞瘤患者诱导治疗的主要方案。然而，至少 10% 的患者对化疗原发难治，且只有 50% 达到 5 年总生存。骨髓是这些患者最常见的转移部位。需要新的方法提高响应率，但神经母细胞瘤免疫微环境的患者间和患者内肿瘤异质性及动态性，使耐药表型的预测极具挑战。本文提出一种新的免疫健全 C57 Bl/6 Th-ALK(F1174L)/MYCN 神经母细胞瘤模型，其中自发性腹部肿瘤由神经嵴中突变 Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase 的表达和 Mycn 的过表达驱动。我们利用该模型生成了一种诱导 COJEC 化疗耐药的个体化给药方案，在该方案中，每只小鼠根据其神经母细胞瘤肿瘤的进展接受化疗周期。我们同时使用单细胞 RNA 测序和空间免疫表型分析，对与 COJEC 耐药相关的肿瘤内在和微环境因素进行了精细的综合分析。我们发现，耐药表型由肾上腺素能和间质性肿瘤细胞中的 Cdk8 上调驱动。免疫抑制性髓系免疫细胞浸润和肿瘤相关基质重塑也促进了 COJEC 耐药。在骨髓中，我们观察到中性粒细胞扩增，以及与微转移疾病相关的 NETosis 证据。我们的结果进一步支持为神经母细胞瘤患者开发靶向 CDK8 的治疗药物，这类药物可能增强抗肿瘤免疫响应。仍需进一步研究界定中性粒细胞和中性粒细胞 NETosis 在神经母细胞瘤进展和转移中的作用。该 C57 Bl/6 模型将对未来免疫调节治疗药物的临床前研究具有重要价值。
